msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a elegant Spanish woman in her fifties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia liquet-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): An elegant Spanish woman in her fifties wearing a sleeveless denim waistcoat with matching wide-leg jeans from the reference, walking at a sunny street in Granada, Spain, with old wooden doors and cobblestones, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia liquet-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown satin shirt with a matching long brown satin skirt and a drawstring waist from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia liquet-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a retro geometric print shirt in green, brown and orange, with blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia liquet-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a blue denim jacket with a grey collar over a rust top, with blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
